claims: Mark Pope is the head coach of the University of Kentucky men’s basketball team.
Mark Pope was hired on April 12, 2024.
Mark Pope was hired to replace John Calipari.
Mark Pope was a captain of the University of Kentucky’s 1996 championship team.
Mark Pope played for the University of Kentucky from 1994 to 1996.
Mark Pope played for the University of Kentucky under Rick Pitino.
Mark Pope won a national championship playing for the University of Kentucky.
Mark Pope was head coach at BYU from 2019 to 2024.
Mark Pope was head coach at Utah Valley from 2015 to 2019.
Mark Pope replaced John Calipari following the 2023–24 season.
Mark Pope is the 23rd men's basketball head coach in University of Kentucky history.
Kenny Brooks was named head coach of the University of Kentucky women's basketball program in March 2024.
